import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    dim = inputs["dim_customer"].copy()
    stg = inputs["stg_customer"].copy()
    fact = inputs["fact_txn"].copy()

    # Ensure proper dtypes
    dim["eff_start_date"] = pd.to_datetime(dim["eff_start_date"])
    dim["eff_end_date"] = pd.to_datetime(dim["eff_end_date"])
    stg["update_date"] = pd.to_datetime(stg["update_date"])
    fact["txn_date"] = pd.to_datetime(fact["txn_date"])

    # ---------- STEP 1: SCD Type 2 load ----------
    max_sk = dim["customer_sk"].max() if len(dim) > 0 else 0
    if pd.isna(max_sk):
        max_sk = 0

    cur = dim[dim["is_current"] == 1][["customer_id", "customer_sk", "segment"]].rename(
        columns={"customer_sk": "cur_sk", "segment": "cur_segment"}
    )

    merged = stg.merge(cur, on="customer_id", how="left")

    has_current = merged["cur_sk"].notna()

    seg_nan_stg = merged["segment"].isna()
    seg_nan_cur = merged["cur_segment"].isna()

    differs = (seg_nan_stg != seg_nan_cur) | (
        (~seg_nan_stg) & (~seg_nan_cur) & (merged["segment"] != merged["cur_segment"])
    )

    creates_version = (~has_current) | differs

    creating = merged[creates_version].copy()
    creating = creating.sort_values("customer_id", kind="mergesort").reset_index(drop=True)
    creating["new_sk"] = max_sk + (creating.index + 1)

    dim_updated = dim.copy()

    expire_rows = creating[creating["cur_sk"].notna()][["customer_id", "update_date"]]
    if len(expire_rows) > 0:
        mapping = dict(zip(expire_rows["customer_id"], expire_rows["update_date"]))
        mask = (dim_updated["is_current"] == 1) & dim_updated["customer_id"].isin(mapping.keys())
        dim_updated.loc[mask, "eff_end_date"] = dim_updated.loc[mask, "customer_id"].map(mapping)
        dim_updated.loc[mask, "is_current"] = 0

    if len(creating) > 0:
        new_rows = pd.DataFrame({
            "customer_sk": creating["new_sk"].astype("int64"),
            "customer_id": creating["customer_id"],
            "segment": creating["segment"],
            "eff_start_date": creating["update_date"],
            "eff_end_date": pd.NaT,
            "is_current": 1,
        })
    else:
        new_rows = pd.DataFrame(columns=dim.columns)

    dim_customer_out = pd.concat([dim_updated, new_rows], ignore_index=True, sort=False)

    # enforce dtypes
    dim_customer_out["customer_sk"] = dim_customer_out["customer_sk"].astype("int64")
    dim_customer_out["customer_id"] = dim_customer_out["customer_id"].astype("int64")
    dim_customer_out["is_current"] = dim_customer_out["is_current"].astype("int64")
    dim_customer_out["eff_start_date"] = pd.to_datetime(dim_customer_out["eff_start_date"])
    dim_customer_out["eff_end_date"] = pd.to_datetime(dim_customer_out["eff_end_date"])

    dim_customer_out = dim_customer_out[
        ["customer_sk", "customer_id", "segment", "eff_start_date", "eff_end_date", "is_current"]
    ]

    # ---------- STEP 2: Key facts against updated dimension ----------
    dim_for_join = dim_customer_out[["customer_id", "customer_sk", "eff_start_date", "eff_end_date"]]

    f = fact.merge(dim_for_join, on="customer_id", how="left")

    cond = (f["eff_start_date"] <= f["txn_date"]) & (
        f["eff_end_date"].isna() | (f["txn_date"] < f["eff_end_date"])
    )

    f_valid = f[cond.fillna(False)]

    key_map = f_valid.drop_duplicates(subset="txn_id")[["txn_id", "customer_sk"]]

    fact_txn_keyed = fact.merge(key_map, on="txn_id", how="left")
    fact_txn_keyed["customer_sk"] = fact_txn_keyed["customer_sk"].fillna(-1).astype("int64")

    fact_txn_keyed = fact_txn_keyed[["txn_id", "customer_sk", "amount"]]

    return {
        "dim_customer_out": dim_customer_out,
        "fact_txn_keyed": fact_txn_keyed,
    }
